B16.v: By measuring line strength we are able to determine if the paraglider lines are in condition to withstand the loads that may occur even in extreme flight conditions (with G-force up to 10g). For this test the most loaded lines are selected; innermost lines of A or B line (C or D if necessary) of all levels are extracted and either loaded up to minimum reqired strength or up to breaking point. The calculation on the right side of the table shows the relation between the required and determined load. The test of the line is successful if the result is more than 100% so the line can withstand the load of the calculated minimum line strength. After the test all used lines are replaced.
